blocks.title: Software nizamon ki tasweeri numaindagi
blocks.text: Software nizamon ki tasweeri numaindagi nizam ki banawat aur rawayye ke pehlu dikhane ke liye tasweeri diagrams istemal karti hai. Yeh pecheeda nizamon ko saada banati hai ta ke developers aur stakeholders unhein aasani se samjhein, un par baat karein aur sambhalein.
Unified Modeling Language (UML) jaise diagrams software ke hisse, un ke rishte aur un ka aapas mein taamul dikhane ke liye aam istemal hote hain.

blocks.prompt: Software development mein diagrams kyun mufeed hain?
blocks.explanation: Yeh pecheeda nizam ko samajhna aasan banate hain, developers aur ghair technical stakeholders ko baat karne ke liye mushtarka tasveer dete hain, aur nizam sambhalne mein madad dete hain.

items: Tasweeri numaindagi: nizam ki banawat aur rawayye ke diagrams; saada karna, rabta, intezam; UML aam mayaar hai.
